ValidationRule.description: Existing FAB methods dispatch on Request Type as a whitelist, so UAEDDS rows pass through untouched. That only holds while UAEDDS rows never carry a FAB request type. This rule enforces it against data loads, flows and manual edits.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Direct_Debit_Request__r.Gateway__c, "UAEDDS"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "New Registration"), ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Collection"), ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Cancellation") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A transaction on a UAEDDS mandate must use a UAEDDS request type. New Registration, Collection and Cancellation route to the FAB gateway and would submit this record to an integration that does not know this mandate.
